batch_prep.station: SAT NIGHT — SPATCHCOCK & DRY BRINE (10 min)
tasks: 1 whole chicken (4–5 lbs) — using kitchen shears, cut along both sides of the backbone and remove it; flip chicken breast-side up; press firmly on breastbone to flatten (spatchcock); dry brine: mix 1.5 tbsp kosher salt + 1 tbsp smoked paprika + 1 tsp garlic powder + 1 tsp black pepper + 1/2 tsp cayenne; rub all over and under skin; place on a wire rack set over a sheet pan; refrigerate uncovered overnight — this dries the skin for a perfect crisp on the smoker

Heat smoker to 275°F using apple wood chips; place spatchcocked chicken skin-side up directly on grate; smoke 2.5–3 hrs until breast hits 160°F (flat bird cooks faster than whole); baste with herb chimichurri every 45 min; pull at 165°F; rest 10 min tented; carve 1/3 of bird for Sunday lunch salad (Smoked Chicken & Watercress); remaining 2/3 is Sunday dinner with chimichurri

MAKE CHIMICHURRI (10 min, while smoker runs): blend 1 cup flat-leaf parsley + 1/4 cup fresh oregano + 4 garlic cloves + 1/4 cup olive oil + 2 tbsp red wine vinegar + 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes + salt + pepper; blend coarse; taste + adjust; jar in fridge — use as baste AND serving sauce

batch_prep.station: BREVILLE OVEN — BATCH CHICKEN THIGHS (prep 15 min | roast 35 min)
tasks: 5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs — pat dry; season half (2.5 lbs) with olive oil + lemon zest + garlic + Italian seasoning for caprese bowls + gyro plates; season other half (2.5 lbs) with olive oil + soy + ginger + sesame oil for soba bowls + watermelon salad; roast all at 400°F for 32–35 min; cool 10 min; slice or shred as needed; label clearly
Reserve ~10 oz UNCOOKED thighs for: Wed drunken noodles ground turkey (use ground turkey for that — so all thighs are batch-roasted)

batch_prep.station: OVEN — EGG WHITE FRITTATA CUPS (prep 12 min | bake 22 min)
tasks: 12-cup muffin tin; whisk 10 egg whites + 4 whole eggs + 6 oz turkey sausage crumbles + 1 cup chopped snap peas + 4 sliced spring onions + 2 oz crumbled feta + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes + salt + pepper; fill cups 3/4 full; bake at 375°F for 20–22 min until puffed and set; cool fully; store airtight up to 5 days
Austin: 4 cups per morning | Cameron: 3 cups per morning + optional avocado side
3 cups dry jasmine rice — makes ~7.5 cups cooked; used for burrito bowls (Fri) and drunken noodles rice base (Wed); divide and refrigerate
Cook 8 oz dry soba noodles in a large pot per package directions; drain, rinse cold, toss with 1 tsp sesame oil to prevent sticking; portion into 2 containers (Thu dinner + Wed lunch)

batch_prep.station: SMOOTHIE BOWL BASES (10 min | freeze overnight Sat)
tasks: Blend 4 smoothie bowl bases in batches: 1 cup frozen mango chunks + 1/2 cup frozen strawberries + 1 scoop vanilla protein powder + 1/2 cup Greek yogurt + splash of almond milk per serving; blend thick (less liquid than a smoothie — it should be spoonable); pour into 4 meal prep containers + freeze; morning-of: pull out 20 min before eating and top with granola + fresh strawberry slices + 1 tbsp almond butter (Austin) or coconut flakes (Cameron)
CHIMICHURRI — see smoker station above; double the batch to use for Sunday lunch salad dressing too
CAPRESE MARINADE / DRIZZLE: 3 tbsp olive oil + 1 tbsp balsamic glaze + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + salt + pepper; whisk; store in small jar
TZATZIKI (Tue gyro): 1 cup Greek yogurt + 1/2 grated cucumber (squeeze dry) + 1 clove garlic minced + 1 tbsp fresh dill + 1 tbsp lemon juice + salt; stir; fridge up to 4 days

MISO BUTTER SAUCE (Thu dinner): 2 tbsp white miso + 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp soy + 1 tbsp mirin + 1 tsp sesame oil + 1/2 tsp grated ginger; whisk together; refrigerate; warm gently before tossing with soba
WATERMELON SALAD DRESSING (Fri/Sat): 2 tbsp olive oil + 1.5 tbsp red wine vinegar + 1 tsp honey + 1/4 tsp Dijon + salt + pepper; shake in jar
2x Caprese Chicken Orzo Bowl per person — Mon/Tue (label A or C; Cameron gets avocado separately)
2x Spicy Thai Cucumber Noodle Salad per person — Wed/Thu (label; Cameron less chili + avocado fresh)
2x Watermelon Arugula Grilled Chicken Salad — Fri/Sat (dress day-of; keep watermelon + arugula separate, slice day-of)
1x Smoked Chicken Watercress Salad — Sun (assemble from Sunday smoker bird)
NEVER put avocado in any container labeled A — Austin allergy
Cameron avocados: 4 whole avocados — store at room temp until ripe, then fridge; slice fresh each day; clearly labeled in fridge
